name: FYT firmware (UIS7862, UIS8581, SC9853i and others)
about: Units sold by many brands that run FYT's firmware. Recognised by FYT's own system service com.syu.ms, not by brand or screen size.
known_launcher: com.android.launcher6 is the factory launcher on UIS7862 units (PimpinPumpkin/fyt7862-mods). FYT's service keeps some apps alive in deep sleep and kills others, so a third-party launcher may need to be on FYT's keep-alive list.
limitations: No FYT unit has been tested with CleanYourHeadUnit yet, so no package here is Recommended.
FYT's Bluetooth stack is tied to its kernel driver: disabling Bluetooth apps does not turn Bluetooth off (XDA).
restore_notes: Only pm disable-user is used. A disabled FYT app comes back with pm enable, and the factory launcher is never disabled.
